raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 14 status='REVERSAL' rows, each with orig_txn_id pointing to an original transaction. silver_transactions keeps only status='POSTED', so those reversal rows are dropped, but their originals stay in silver and gold, which overstates totals. The fix is to also exclude any transaction referenced by a REVERSAL row's orig_txn_id; this is an inference from the field names and has not been verified against the settlement file.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
